library.title: Event templates
library.description: Reusable event setups: days, categories with rulesets, rounds, tables and planner blocks. Teams, judges and results are never part of a template.
library.uploadHint: A template file (.json) downloaded from this or another Judge26 installation.
library.empty: No templates yet. Save an event as a template, or upload a template file.
library.confirmDelete: Delete the template “{name}”? Events created from it are not affected.

save.title: Save as template
save.description: The template keeps the days pattern, categories with their active rulesets, rounds, tables, planner columns and blocks. Teams, judges, games and scores are never included.
save.managerHint: Only admins keep templates in the library. Download the file and give it to an admin, or upload it on another installation.

create.title: New event from template
create.description: All dates move so the template’s first day falls on the day you choose. The new event does not change when the template changes.
create.seasonHint: Empty: the year of the first day.
create.venueHint: Empty: the venue of the template.
create.noTemplates: There are no templates yet. Save an event as a template or upload a template file first.

setup.title: Setup
setup.description: What this event still needs, from the days to a published schedule. Steps can be done in any order once the data they build on exists.

days.title: Competition days
days.todo: Add the days of the event and their hours.
